name: ehos-dev
description: Skills shared by eh-os, ehos-tools and eh-os-contract: how a changelog line is written and a component released (eh-os D-91), how a planned piece of work is run through a GitHub issue, how a change is reviewed before its pull request, how a decision record is written in eh-os and ehos-tools, how eh-os's architecture is kept current with a change, and how Elixir and its tests are written in the three.
